name: HAX posters and social media
note: Stills live in git. Video, GIF and print PDFs live as assets on the release above so they don't bloat the repo's history.

posters.title: 1880s steam age
posters.alt: Sepia Victorian engraving-style poster: "The Grand & Marvellous HAX, Open Source Authoring Engine" with brass gears, a human, the Future Traveler and a lightbulb forming Humans + Agents = Experience, above seven stone pillars labeled with the HAX pillars on a Ubiquity base.

posters.title: 1900s modern marvel
posters.alt: Cream Art Nouveau poster: "HAX, a Modern Marvel of the New Century" with a human, the Future Traveler and a lightbulb, a Headless Authoring Experience ribbon and seven pillars on a Ubiquity base.

posters.title: 1920s roaring twenties
posters.alt: Black and gold Art Deco poster: "The Cat's Pajamas presents HAX, Humans + Agents = Amazing Experience" with seven gold-lined pillars on Ubiquity and the line "Humans lead. Agents help. Ideas ship."

posters.title: 1970s rainbow
posters.alt: Warm 1970s poster with a rainbow arch over chunky HAX lettering, three circular badges for humans, agents and experience, and seven striped pillars on Ubiquity. Tagline: "Every era had its tools. This one's yours."

posters.title: 1980s corporate (Paul Rand homage)
posters.alt: Striped black-and-white 1980s corporate poster riffing on Paul Rand: pixel human, Future Traveler and lightbulb above striped HAX letters, with seven striped pillars on Ubiquity.
posters.note: Riffs on Paul Rand's striped corporate identity work; reviewed and kept, November 2026.

posters.title: 1980s cyberpunk
posters.alt: Neon pink and cyan cyberpunk poster on a dark grid: glowing HAX, Humans + Agents = Experience in neon frames and seven neon pillars on Ubiquity.

posters.title: 1990s early web
posters.alt: Early-web style poster with rainbow WordArt-like HAX, a Windows-style dialog showing Humans + Agents = Experience, a Headless Authoring Experience banner, seven pillars and a "Ubiquity 100%" progress bar.

posters.title: Game Boy
posters.alt: Four-shade green handheld-console poster: HAX in pixel type, "Open Source, Est. 2017", humans + agents = experience sprites and seven pixel pillars on Ubiquity.
posters.note: Homage to the Nintendo Game Boy look; reviewed and kept, November 2026.

posters.title: Game Boy Advance
posters.alt: Bright handheld-console poster in pink, blue and green pixel type with humans + agents = experience sprites and seven colored pillars on Ubiquity.
posters.note: Homage to the Game Boy Advance look; reviewed and kept, November 2026.

posters.title: PlayStation
posters.alt: Pale grey 32-bit console poster: chunky 3D HAX letters in red, teal and green, a pixel explorer + the Future Traveler = a lightbulb, and seven 3D colored pillars on Ubiquity. Tagline: "Every era had its tools. This one's yours."
posters.note: Homage to the original PlayStation boot look; reviewed and kept, November 2026.

posters.title: Hacker
posters.alt: Black terminal-style poster with HAX built from ASCII blocks, a hooded human, the Future Traveler and a lightbulb, and glitching ASCII pillars on Ubiquity.
posters.note: Inspired by hacker-game aesthetics (Watch Dogs); reviewed and kept, November 2026.

posters.title: HAX Quest
posters.alt: Green Game Boy-style RPG battle: the Future Traveler casts the seven pillars as spells at THE VOID, a dark cloud saying "Nothing matters." Menu: Learn, Build, Remix, Grow, with Run and Hide crossed out. QR code to hax.psu.edu.
posters.note: Handheld RPG battle-screen homage; reviewed and kept, November 2026.

posters.title: HAX Quest comic
posters.alt: "The Quest: Future Traveler vs the Void" as four Game Boy-style battle panels, ending with "Create your future!" and a QR code.
posters.note: Handheld RPG battle-screen homage; reviewed and kept, November 2026.

posters.title: You made it to the future
posters.alt: Starry 8-bit poster: "STOP: NOW. You made it to the future." Humans + Agents = Amazing Experience, seven pillars on Ubiquity, "Start building." and a QR code.

posters.title: World of Tomorrow: UBIQUITY
posters.alt: 1960s travel-poster style: a pixel Future Traveler beside a geodesic sphere, rocket and rainbow on a red planet, tinted in all seven pillar colors. Title "UBIQUITY", tagline "The home of the future, now!", with a QR code and hax.psu.edu.
posters.note: Inspired by 1960s world-of-tomorrow and space travel posters; reviewed and kept, November 2026.

posters.title: Select a Pillar
posters.alt: NES-style "Push start, select a pillar" grid: eight-bit heads for the seven pillars, the Future Traveler in the center and THE VOID, with a QR code to hax.psu.edu.
posters.note: Homage to an 8-bit boss-select screen; reviewed and kept, November 2026.

posters.title: Bulletin board
posters.alt: A campus bulletin board covered in the HAX posters, some peeling, under the banner "HAX: Take one. Skill up. Build the future." Pixel students reach up to read them; the Void looms on the left and a bright future city glows on the right, where the Future Traveler waits.
